bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Danish-Swedish Farmdog core series (DA2PP / DHPP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a small puppy is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 15-20 lb (7-9 kg), Danish-Swedish Farmdog visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring hip dysplasia and patellar luxation into the Danish-Swedish Farmdog exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Danish-Swedish Farmdog still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Danish-Swedish Farmdog boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Danish-Swedish Farmdog row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Danish-Swedish Farmdog item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Danish-Swedish Farmdog kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Danish-Swedish Farmdog due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Danish-Swedish Farmdog core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Danish-Swedish Farmdog misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Danish-Swedish Farmdog health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Danish-Swedish Farmdog adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
